summary: Vishay Intertechnology filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a follow-on equity offering of 15,000,000 shares (plus 2,250,000 option shares fully exercised) at $50.00 per share, expecting net proceeds of ~$830.3 million after discounts and expenses. The company will use net proceeds to accelerate growth initiatives and reduce borrowings under its senior secured credit facility. The offering was conducted under an automatic shelf registration statement and is expected to close July 1, 2026. The board's recommendation is not applicable. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation, and accordingly is classified as None.
